summary: Defines extensions to the pseudowire control protocol and its IANA allocations needed to set up time-division multiplexing (TDM) pseudowires over MPLS networks. TDM pseudowires carry traditional circuit-style telephone-type traffic across a packet network, and this document adds the signaling pieces they require. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: Old phone lines send a steady stream of timed pulses. This explains how to carry that stream through a modern packet network, like running an old train line through a new tunnel.
